note: H10, replication. meatValue 24 -> 40 on v0.55. On v0.54 this arm survived 92.2% to day 800 against the matched control's 66.7% (47/51 vs 32/48, Fisher two-sided p=0.0022) with cv 50.4 vs 62.7 -- the largest survival effect any arm has produced in this project -- while carnivory did NOT move (0.070 vs 0.061) and GRAZE stayed at 95.9%. The mechanism is therefore not a diet shift: predation share rose 54.4 -> 64.1% and SCAVENGE 0.36 -> 0.61%, so the animal level appears to be recovering more energy from its own dead. That is a real finding on one block and needs a fresh-seed replication before meatValue 40 is promoted as a default.
